metadata.title: April 04, 2003 - Martha and Jimmy
metadata.author: By Cathy Millhauser / Edited by Mike Shenk
metadata.copyright: © 2003 Wall Street Journal - Litzed by Lloyd

entries.clue: "All this cookware! What's your favorite, Martha?"
They're Red or White on diamonds
"This is some fancy place you have!"
"What do you call your friend at ImClone?"
"People are said to hate you or love you. What do you hear from them?"
"What can you say about the current period?"
"If you go to jail, will all these beautiful things fit in your cell?"
"I see. So what will you bring?"
"Any thoughts on how you might escape?"
